北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云风力 5 级，体感舒适。外出注意防晒防风哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy with 5-level wind. Feel comfortable, protect from sun and wind!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天温度适中，体感 27℃ 很舒服。记得带伞！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and warm, feels comfortable. Don't forget your umbrella!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云体感 27℃，湿度 65%。外出注意防晒，保持好心情！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels 27℃ with 65% humidity. Enjoy your day!
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天体感 33℃ 较高。外出记得防暑防晒，多喝水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels 33℃, quite hot. Stay cool, sun-protected and hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天体感 30℃，湿度 76%。体感较闷热，注意防暑！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen feels 30℃, quite muggy with 76% humidity. Stay cool!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天 31℃ 稍热，湿度 38%。体感干燥，记得多补水！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and hot, feels dry. Remember to hydrate!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天 29℃，湿度适中。外出记得带伞，保持愉快！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and 29℃. Take an umbrella and enjoy your day!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 21℃ 较凉。风力 4 级，出门添衣防风哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and cool, feels 21℃ with wind. Dress warmly!
成都.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降7℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天体感 29℃ 较舒适。记得带伞，出行保持好心情！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels 29℃. Take an umbrella and enjoy your trip!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天 25℃，湿度 68%。感觉有点闷，注意添衣保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and 25℃, feels a bit muggy. Dress appropriately!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天 25℃ 凉爽舒适。湿度 51%，记得出门带把伞哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and cool at 25℃. Bring an umbrella just in case!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天风大，体感 23℃ 凉爽。湿度低，记得多补水！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy with strong wind, feels cool. Low humidity, stay hydrated!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天风力 5 级，体感 22℃ 舒适。紫外线强，注意防晒！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny with strong wind, feels 22℃. Strong UV, use sun protection!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天体感 17℃ 较凉，风力 4 级。出门记得添衣防风！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and cool, feels 17℃ with wind. Dress warmly!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，体感 25℃。湿度 83% 较大，出行注意交通安全！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy, feels 25℃. High humidity, drive safe and take care!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾风力 4 级，体感 11℃ 湿冷。出行请注意保暖慢行！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy with wind, feels 11℃ and damp. Dress warm, drive slow!
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云体感 10℃ 较凉，湿度 90%。记得添衣，注意防潮！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and cool, feels 10℃. High humidity, dress warm and stay dry!
